summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered XML Tables 5 and 6 into row-level activity evidence, reclassified unsupported viral database rows as conflicts, preserved database-only/source-conflict cautions, and replaced pending mechanism notes with source-located membrane-permeabilization claims.
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 accepted the paper with cautions after bounded local source recovery; no blocking owner-layer rework remains for worker-2, worker-4, or worker-6.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP rows were rechecked against source XML tables, recovered supplementary DOCX text/tables, and packet database snapshots. Literature rows remain source_verified; unsupported assay rows are preserved as source_conflict/database_only rather than smoothed into primary evidence; viral IC50 rows were demoted from source_verified to source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: XML Tables 2-6 now have row-level activity/toxicity/model-membrane or combination-index records with endpoint, raw value, unit or unitless index, target, conditions, and source locators. Table 5 EC50 values and Table 6 MIC/MBC/ΣFIC/ΣFBC values were repaired from primary XML.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are constrained to source-located membrane permeabilization, liposome CF release, and DLS/CD context. Model-membrane evidence is not overclaimed as live-cell killing.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Many linked DBAASP assay rows remain source_conflict/database_only_no_primary_source because the primary paper does not exactly support every database target/value row; these are retained as curated conflicts, not hidden.
Table 5 liposome EC50 values are model-membrane activity rows and are not normalized into MIC/MBC antimicrobial endpoints.
The local XML/PDF/source supplementary DOCX and database snapshots were sufficient for owner-layer rework even though one remote OA package fetch was unavailable in prior material tooling.
